suggestion: Add a one-screen decision brief per slate: model number vs market number vs difference, key depth losses, and the three biggest open questions.
option_a: A: static brief page generated per slate
option_b: B: brief embedded at the top of lines.html
recommended_path: B — embed in lines.html so the decision context and the numbers live together
why: Decision quality improves when the difference columns and the injury depth load are visible in one place.

suggestion: Acquire a licensed odds archive to release VG-02 and populate market_line, line_difference, CLV and ROI.
recommended_path: B first (fastest), evaluate A if volume grows
why: Without prices the leaderboard cannot graduate from diagnostics to qualification.

suggestion: Automate close-snapshot capture at each kickoff window (scheduled job reading official pages into the store).
option_a: A: scheduled GitHub Action storing raw input snapshots
option_b: B: agent-session capture at each kickoff window
option_c: C: manual capture (not acceptable per requirements)
recommended_path: A with fail-closed parsing: store raw text first, parse only fields with tests
why: The store requires close numbers for every market; automation removes timing luck from capture.

suggestion: Read the 16 remaining club depth charts so every replacement event carries a verified depth string.
option_a: A: one follow-up session reads all charts
option_b: B: one club per slate week
recommended_path: A — bounded, mechanical, and immediately removes flag N6F-08
why: Depth of replacement is the requested tracking metric; breadth is currently the gap.

suggestion: Replace the single-sigma normal margin model with a calibrated margin distribution on multi-season verified results.
recommended_path: B once enough verified results exist; publish n and out-of-sample tests
why: Fair moneylines and demotion rules depend on honest win probabilities.

suggestion: Keep leaderboard ranking on signal metrics only; never let staking results influence rank or promotion.
recommended_path: A — the requirement explicitly separates signal from staking
why: Blended scores let lucky staking runs mask bad signals.

suggestion: Add a per-game depth load metric (sum of string-weighted replacements) to the lines table as a separate column.
recommended_path: C — count answers 'how many', string-weighted load answers 'how deep'
why: The requirement asks for depth of replacement, not just the fact.

suggestion: Publish a Flagged-for-Review queue sorted by severity with one-click source links (already present; add severity counts to the dashboard).
recommended_path: A — cheap and keeps the landing page a decision surface
why: Reviewers should see the worst irregularities first.

suggestion: Publish bootstrap intervals beside Fisher-z intervals for correlations once n >= 50.
recommended_path: C — intervals agree or they don't; either way it is information
why: Small-n intervals are fragile; agreement between methods is a useful check.

suggestion: Extend the results feed to every game since 2026 Week 1 (official scores pages) to grow the settlement base.
option_a: A: backfill all weeks in one session
option_b: B: backfill one week per session
recommended_path: A — mechanical and it multiplies every future n
why: Every gate that needs n needs verified results first.

suggestion: Run the demotion gate evaluation as an automated check in CI once live strategies exist.
option_a: A: CI job evaluating DG rules per settlement
recommended_path: A — the gate must be mechanical to be trusted
why: A demotion gate that relies on memory does not demote.

suggestion: Keep the project non-commercial and informational; obtain legal review before any commercial or wagering use of NFL data.
why: NFL.com terms restrict systematic retrieval and gambling-related use (S6CF-17).
